title: 第21章 泰坦血牛怎么就燃起来了第22章 赤炎金精
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
泰坦血牛这玩意吧，很神奇。
b级的巨力双头蟒如果开出来c级的御兽，就只是一只普通的蟒蛇而已。
泰坦血牛更坑。
a级的泰坦血牛御兽蛋，如果开出来的是b级御兽，就会变成b级巨力牛。
这是一种战略物资御兽，只要任何人开出来，就必须无偿献给帝国。
因为它既没有任何攻击力，又因为体型庞大，可以当做运输车辆，向前线运输物资，还会因为其庞大的躯体和鲜嫩的口感，被前线拿来当战略口粮。
而如果开出来的是s级御兽则更坑。
s级御兽圣光血牛，是更高级的战略物资，还是普通人禁止持有的的那种。
因为。。。它就是一个移动炸药库！
s级御兽圣光血牛，唯一的攻击技能，一生能且只能释放一次，叫做圣光制裁。
它会压缩自己全身的能量，然后自爆，浑身上下，从血肉到灵魂，全都化为无差别攻击的圣光。
存活时间越长的圣光血牛自爆威力就越大。
任何人开出圣光血牛不上交，则直接视为谋逆！
那么就要有人问了，为什么帝国不直接将所有泰坦血牛的御兽蛋收集起来，自己孵化呢？
答案只有一个。
帝国不愿意多花钱！
一枚a级御兽蛋的价格是300万帝国币。
只有低于150万，帝国才会大批量收购御兽蛋。
可御兽蛋的产出全靠副本。

试想一下，你辛辛苦苦进副本，卖命一样的攻略下来，却只打到了一枚a级御兽蛋。
你愿不愿意将它按照b级御兽蛋的价格卖出去？
所以，除了那些不差钱的队伍会低价卖给帝国之外，其他打到a级御兽蛋泰坦血牛的人，都会选择留在自己手中。
陈小草之所以为八次兄默哀，正是因为如此。
八次啊！
那可是足足两千四百万帝国币的支出。
看样子，他算是为帝国免费送去了2400万了。
【怎么样？怕了吧？】
【别以为我不知道你的小心思，哪怕开出品级不符的御兽，你大不了付账之后，亏损一点，把御兽拿走。】
【呵呵~上一个幸运的小伙子没有被你骗到，你以为我就会轻易的相信你？】
【这一次，只要你敢再立下赌约，一旦开不出来a级的泰坦血牛，你必然会血本无归！】
【露出真面目吧，死骗子！】
陈小草：。。。？？？
这人，怎么莫名其妙的燃起来了？
“那个。。。八次兄，你说的我都懂，现在，你可以连麦签合约了吗？”
“嘎？”
正沉浸在揭破骗子真面目，吓的对方不敢继续行骗，拯救万千御兽师于水火之中的美丽幻想中的唐柏猛的一噎。
【你确定？】
陈小草烦了，三下五除二写好了一份合约发了出来。
大体意思和乔简签的那份一样。

只要陈小草帮助【被直播鉴蛋连骗八次】挑选出一枚能开出a级御兽泰坦血牛的御兽蛋。
后者就会付出同等价值的帝国币或者其他御兽材料。
反之，整个御兽蛋的费用由陈小草独自承担。
content_en:
;;
The Titan Blood Ox thing is amazing.
If a B-level giant double-headed python is released as a C-level beast, it will be just an ordinary python.
Titan Blood Bull is even more deceptive.
If the A-level Titan Blood Ox Taming Egg is opened as a B-level Taming Beast, it will become a B-level Titan Blood Ox.
This is a strategic material beast. As long as anyone opens it, it must be donated to the empire for free.
Because it has no offensive power, and because of its large size, it can be used as a transport vehicle to transport supplies to the front line. Because of its large body and fresh taste, it is used as strategic rations by the front line.
And if it is an S-level beast, it will be even more embarrassing.
The S-level beast-controlling holy light blood cow is a higher-level strategic material, and it is the kind that ordinary people are prohibited from possessing.
because. . . It's a mobile explosives depot!
The only attack skill of the S-level beast-controlling Holy Light Blood Ox, which can and can only be released once in a lifetime, is called Holy Light Sanction.
It will compress the energy of its whole body, and then self-destruct, and its entire body, from flesh and blood to soul, will turn into holy light that attacks indiscriminately.
The longer the Holy Light Blood Ox survives, the greater its self-destruction power will be.
Anyone who fails to turn in the Holy Light Blood Ox will be directly regarded as treason!
Then someone has to ask, why doesn't the empire just collect all the beast-control eggs of the Titan blood cows and hatch them themselves?
There is only one answer.
The empire is not willing to spend more money!
The price of an A-grade beast-controlling egg is 3 million imperial coins.
Only if the price is less than 1.5 million, the empire will purchase beast eggs in large quantities.
The production of controllable beast eggs depends entirely on copies.
Just imagine, you worked so hard to enter the dungeon and worked your butt off to complete the strategy, but you only managed to get an A-level beast-controlling egg.
Are you willing to sell it for the price of a B-level beast egg?
Therefore, except for those teams that are not short of money and will sell them to the empire at a low price, other people who have obtained the A-level beast-control egg Titan Blood Ox will choose to keep it in their hands.
The reason why Chen Xiaocao mourned Brother Eight Times was precisely because of this.
Eight times!
That was a total expenditure of 24 million imperial coins.
It seems that he gave 24 million to the empire for free.
【How about it? Are you scared? 】
[Don’t think that I don’t know your little thoughts. Even if I buy a beast that doesn’t match the grade, the worst you can do is pay the bill, make a small loss, and take the beast away. 】
[Haha~ The last lucky young man was not deceived by you. Do you think I will believe you easily? 】
[This time, as long as you dare to make another bet, if you cannot get an A-level Titan Blood Bull, you will definitely lose everything! 】
[Show your true colors, you damn liar! 】
Chen Xiaocao:. . . ? ? ?
Why did this man get so inexplicably ignited?
"Um... Brother Bachi, I understand everything you said. Now, can you sign the contract with Lian Mai?"
"Gah?"
Tang Bai was immersed in the beautiful fantasy of exposing the true face of the liar, scaring the other party from continuing to deceive, and saving thousands of beast masters from fire and water, and suddenly choked.
【Are you sure? 】
Chen Xiaocao was annoyed, so he wrote a contract and sent it out.
The general meaning is the same as the one signed by Qiao Jian.
As long as Chen Xiaocao helps [who was deceived eight times in a row by live broadcast egg appraisal] to pick out a beast-taming egg that can produce an A-level beast-taming titan blood cow.
The latter will pay the same value of imperial coins or other beast control materials.
On the contrary, Chen Xiaocao will bear the entire cost of the beast egg alone.
